title: Study plan, milestones and revision checkpoints
learningObjectives: Explain the concept and its relevant rules.

understand.concept: A study plan divides the curriculum into manageable sessions with learning goals, practice tasks and checkpoints. Revision should revisit earlier concepts through retrieval practice and cumulative problems rather than relying only on rereading.
understand.whyItMatters: Milestones make progress visible and help learners identify weak topics before a cumulative assessment.
understand.analogy: Treat standards, interfaces and release steps as explicit contracts that make assumptions visible.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy does not replace the C standard, implementation documentation or project-specific requirements.
